narr: The combined Oklahoma and Texas Panhandles saw a brief break in severe storms on the 4th and 5th of June. Once the 6th of June came around severe storms showed back up under favorable conditions through the 8th of June. An unstable environment rich with moisture with the help of different rounds of upper-level disturbances and surface boundaries helped created severe thunderstorms that produced localized heavy rain, hail up to 1.75���, and damaging winds estimated to be upwards of 80 mph. Each day from the 6th to 8th had a couple of discrete storms but mostly lines of storms that moved through parts of the combined Panhandles creating these severe storms.
